segments.description: Coaches, please welcome Thomas Gracker to the Virtual Grants and Coaches Conference. Thomas holds a master's degree in tennis coaching and sports science, and he runs Open Pro Tennis Academy based at the Ballarat Regional Tennis Center. He's also the founder of Connect2Coach. Throughout his 20 years of tennis coaching career, Thomas has successfully grown and managed a number of highly successful tennis programs in Slovakia and in Australia, and worked closely with the Tennis Australia Talent Development Hot Shots and Coach Education programs. His experiences working closely with fellow coaches, athletes, and parents highlighted a need for a better program management tool within our industry. Driven by a desire to support coaches like himself, Thomas founded Connect2Coach. Connect2Coach is a cutting edge mobile application designed to streamline communication, enhance organization, and optimize coaching practices within sporting clubs. Connect2Coach provides a comprehensive platform that connects coaches, players, and parents and club administrators in one convenient user-friendly interface. We welcome Thomas to walk us through it. Hi, everyone. My name is Thomas Gracker, and I'm founder of Connect2Coach. I'm very excited to share what Connect2Coach is about and how it will help our coaching industry to streamline our businesses. So let me tell you about the presentation itself
